title: Norwegian Velvety Potato Casserole
description: A creamy, comforting casserole filled with norwegian potatoes, velvety sauce and a hint of richness.
instructions: In a large pan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add thinly sliced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in velvety sauce and cook for a further 2 minutes.
Transfer potato mixture to a baking dish.
If using cheese, sprinkle over the top.
Pour milk over the potato mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and top is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
